effect_entries.effect: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.
effect_entries.short_effect: Blocks damaging attacks and lowers attacking Pokémon’s Attack by two stages on contact.  Switches Aegislash to Shield Forme.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: Prend une posture défensive pour bloquer les dégâts. Diminue fortement l’Attaque de tout Pokémon qui entre en contact avec le lanceur.
The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack stat of any attacker who makes direct contact.
